name: LAVA Coffee
address: 61 Quang Trung, Ward 10, Go Vap District, HCMC.
description_short: LAVA Coffee is a famous rooftop cafe, ideal for simple dates or lively conversations among Saigon's youth.
description_detail: You will feel like you are lost in a European cafe space because of the gentle atmosphere that Lava Coffee brings. The interior is made of wood with luxurious dark tones. Located in the center of Go Vap district, it offers Lava-flavored cakes and European-standard drinks that will surely not disappoint you.

name: Du Mien Garden
address: 7 Phan Van Tri, Ward 10, Go Vap District, HCMC.
description_short: The shop has a spacious space, filled with green trees like a miniature park, bringing a relaxing feeling to every customer.
description_detail: The most attractive point of Du Mien Garden is its successful creation of a green space. It is covered by ancient trees providing shade, colorful flowers, and the sound of trickling streams. Therefore, every diner seems to feel immersed in nature even though they are living in the midst of the hustle and bustle of the busiest city in the country.

name: Saigon Chic
address: 82 Street No. 27, Ward 6, Go Vap District, HCMC.
description_short: If you are looking for a place that is both airy and beautiful for photos, suitable for working and dating – Saigon Chic is a very good choice in Go Vap.
description_detail: The shop harmoniously combines the vintage style of old Saigon with modern minimalism, creating a feeling that is both cozy and slightly luxurious. Thanks to the large garden, many trees, and a small pond in the middle, the shop brings an airy, relaxing feeling – very suitable for relieving stress after school or work. Inside, the decor is meticulous, with many natural photo corners.

name: Thuc Coffee
address: 45 Nguyen Oanh, Ward 10, Go Vap District.
description_short: Thuc Coffee Go Vap is an ideal meeting place for night owls and creatives - open 24/7, with a gentle, quiet two-story space, wood decor, and yellow lights creating a cozy feeling.
description_detail: Thuc Coffee stands out with warm, rustic tones. The interior is mainly brown wood, black iron, combined with green trees and soft yellow light, creating a cozy, gentle, and relaxing feeling. This tone brings a modern vintage look and helps customers easily feel a close, chill, and comfortable space to sit for a long time. This is an ideal place to study, work, or chat.

name: Oasis Cafe
address: 26/14 Pham Van Dong, Ward 3, Go Vap District, HCMC.
description_short: Oasis Café is like a “green castle” in the city: interiors simulating magnificent European buildings, blended with green trees and Koi ponds, creating a romantic, magical feeling.
description_detail: Oasis Café is a green oasis in the heart of the city, with the appearance of an ancient European castle mixed with modern touches. The shop has a large Koi pond, trees everywhere, and many different seating areas, creating a very relaxing and romantic feeling. The exquisite design on many floors and unique walkways make this place look like a work of art.

name: Ngay Xua Ay Coffee
address: 525/5 Quang Trung, Ward 10, Go Vap District, HCMC.
description_short: The shop brings a deep sense of nostalgia: an ancient space with wooden shelves, pendulum clocks, radios, and many memorabilia from the subsidy period, like a journey back in time.
description_detail: Ngay Xua Ay Coffee has a vintage style - deep nostalgia: the shop is decorated with old memorabilia such as cassettes, antique radios, rotary phones, along with wooden shelves and rustic wood furniture, reminiscent of old Saigon. The space is gentle, peaceful with warm light, creating the feeling of being lost in a grandparents' house in the old days.

name: Country House Coffee
address: 18 Phan Van Tri, Ward 10, Go Vap District, HCMC.
description_short: Country House Coffee is like a “miniature castle” in the middle of Saigon with a spacious garden, lush green trees, gentle waterfalls, and classic wooden houses.
description_detail: Country House Coffee is a garden cafe in the style of a European countryside village: you will see wooden houses, white fences, windmills, climbing plants, grass carpets, and small waterfalls - creating the feeling of a peaceful village in the heart of Saigon. The interior includes iron chairs, colorful sofas, and cushions, bringing a romantic and comfortable space.

name: Chon Binh Yen Coffee
address: 965/128/83 Quang Trung, Ward 14, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Chon Binh Yen Coffee brings a gentle, green, and quiet vibe just like its name (Peaceful Place), a shelter in Go Vap for you to temporarily escape the noisy pace of life.
description_detail: Chon Binh Yen Coffee has a rustic, minimalist style blended with green trees and natural light, creating the feeling of a miniature Da Lat in the middle of Go Vap with hydrangeas as a highlight. The space is covered with greenery, soothing brown wood and white tones, and abundant natural light. The music is played softly, mainly acoustic and gentle indie.

name: Family Garden Café
address: 438 Phan Van Tri, Ward 7, Go Vap District, HCMC.
description_short: Family Garden Café in Go Vap impresses with its large garden space, filled with green trees and winding paths like stepping into a miniature tropical garden.
description_detail: It is a large garden cafe with many trees, flowers, and a lake dotted with fountains, creating the feeling of a miniature park. At night, lanterns and flowers shine brightly, creating a romantic, shimmering space for photos or relaxation. The shop has a cool outdoor seating area, air-conditioned rooms, and a decor style that blends nature - warm and comfortable.

name: DEERA GARDEN
address: 463/69 Le Duc Tho, Ward 16, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Deera Garden impresses with its shimmering, green, and extremely chill garden space both day and night.
description_detail: Deera Garden brings a poetic Da Lat vibe to the heart of Saigon, where every step feels like getting lost in a peaceful garden with greenery, flowers, and stone-paved paths. Sunlight shines through the leaves, blending with cozy seating corners, creating a gentle, relaxing feeling like sipping coffee in the mountain morning mist.

name: Airplane Spotting Cafe
address: 389/24 Quang Trung, Ward 10, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Dat Sai Gon - Airplane Spotting Cafe is an ideal destination for aviation lovers and open spaces.
description_detail: Dat Sai Gon - Airplane Spotting Cafe is a unique destination not to be missed in Saigon, standing out thanks to its prime location on the rooftop of a high-rise building, offering a direct and panoramic view of Tan Son Nhat airport.

name: Roll D' Die - The Boardgame Café
address: 688/24 Le Duc Tho, Ward 15, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Roll D' Die is an ideal boardgame cafe where you can enjoy drinks while participating in fun intellectual battles with friends.
description_detail: Roll D' Die offers a unique coffee experience, going beyond simple drink enjoyment. The shop is designed to maximize boardgame needs, with a cozy layout that can be divided into separate areas.

name: Chiin Coffee & Cinema
address: 14 Nguyen Van Nghi, Ward 5, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Chiin Coffee & Cinema is a unique 'All-in-One' entertainment complex, going beyond the traditional cafe model.
description_detail: Chiin Coffee & Cinema operates as a diverse service complex, turning this place into a miniature entertainment center right in Go Vap. The shop not only provides drinks but has also expanded into high-end entertainment and accommodation.

name: Emotions Coffee & Art
address: 352/8 Nguyen Oanh, Ward 17, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Emotions Coffee & Art at alley 352 Nguyen Oanh is a peaceful oasis in the heart of Go Vap, standing out with a harmonious combination of coffee space and art.
description_detail: Emotions Coffee & Art successfully creates a 'Quiet Space' by taking advantage of its location deep in alley 352 Nguyen Oanh, helping to eliminate most city noise. The shop's design style is often minimalist, rustic with warm dark tones, or uses many green trees to create a feeling of closeness to nature.

name: Symbol Coffee & Tea
address: 304 Nguyen Thai Son, Ward 1, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Symbol Coffee & Tea is a modern cafe, standing out with impressive, synchronized space design and rich brand identity.
description_detail: Symbol Coffee & Tea at 304 Nguyen Thai Son impresses customers at first sight thanks to its unique, modern, and synchronized architectural design. The shop usually has a large area, divided into many zones and floors, creating a variety of seating spaces: from high tables suitable for quick work, comfortable sofas for groups of friends to airy balconies overlooking the street.

name: VIP COFFEE
address: 29/61 Le Duc Tho, Ward 1, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: VIP COFFEE at 29/61 Le Duc Tho offers a cozy space, minimalist but sophisticated interior, very suitable for those looking for a quiet place to study or work.
description_detail: VIP COFFEE at this address is designed in a warm, minimalist style, inspired by European cafes with dark tones, wooden furniture, and soft yellow light, creating a 'chill' and relaxing feeling upon entering. The shop is usually smartly arranged to create private corners and comfortable seating areas.

name: Tiem Ca Phe Cua Ngoai
address: 543/1 Phan Van Tri, Ward 7, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Tiem Ca Phe Cua Ngoai recreates the old Saigon space with a vintage, simple, and warm decoration style.
description_detail: Tiem Ca Phe Cua Ngoai is a masterpiece of space design, creating a rare multi-dimensional experience. Upon entering, customers will be surprised by a large ancient tree standing tall, blending into the shop, creating natural shade and a fresh atmosphere. The overall space is deeply nostalgic.

name: Tiem Ca Phe Me Go Vap
address: 672A50 Phan Van Tri, Ward 10, Go Vap District, HCMC
description_short: Tiem Ca Phe Me Go Vap (Me Coffee & Tea) is currently one of the hottest spots in Saigon thanks to its unique themed decoration style combining classic and modern.
description_detail: Tiem Ca Phe Me Go Vap has invested heavily to create a space 'beyond imagination' at two corner facades on Phan Van Tri street. Customers coming here feel like they are lost in a fairy tale world with hundreds of teddy bears hung, placed, and arranged densely from the ceiling, balcony, to table corners. No longer just a classic look, the shop brings a modern, dynamic vibe.
